news.title: Introducing the new Copilot with Home, Code and Autopilot
news.summary_raw:
We’re reimagining Microsoft Copilot to enable work as it evolves and to help expand what every individual and every organization can accomplish in the flow of human ambition. Today we’re introducing the new Copilot to connect the tools people rely on with the next generation of capabilities they’ll need to build, customize and scale AI...
The post Introducing the new Copilot with Home, Code and Autopilot appeared first on The Official Microsoft Blog.
news.summary: Microsoft launches a refreshed Copilot suite featuring Home, Code, and Autopilot modules, integrating AI across the Microsoft 365 ecosystem. This update extends Copilot’s capabilities to build, customize, and scale AI-driven workflows directly within familiar Office tools.
news.enterprise_use: S1: Go to the Microsoft 365 Admin Center and review the new Copilot settings for Home, Code, and Autopilot in the AI Features tab this week. S2: Failure to adopt these settings risks missing out on streamlined automation, reduced manual editing, and potential security gaps if the new AI controls are not enabled. S3: The most affected tools are Outlook, Teams, and SharePoint, where Copilot can now assist with content creation, code generation, and automated task management.

news.title: Introducing Gemini 3.8 Live with Live Avatar
news.summary: Google DeepMind has released Gemini 3.8 Live, a real-time AI model featuring live avatar capabilities for interactive, multimodal conversations. This update enhances Google’s generative AI portfolio, offering new possibilities for dynamic user interfaces across Workspace and other Google services.
news.enterprise_use: Go to the Google Cloud Console and enable the Gemini 3.8 Live API under the AI & Machine Learning section this week. Failure to adopt the new API risks missing out on low‑latency, multimodal interactions that can replace manual support scripts and improve user experience; it also opens opportunities to integrate live avatars into helpdesk chatbots via Freshservice or custom SSO flows. The most directly affected tool is Google Workspace Admin Console, where the new model can be plugged into automated ticketing and user onboarding workflows.

news.title: OpenAI extends cyber access to Ukraine for civilian defense
news.summary_raw: OpenAI is extending access to its Daybreak program to the Government of Ukraine to support the cyber defense of civilian infrastructure.
news.summary: OpenAI is expanding its Daybreak cyber defense program to include the Government of Ukraine, providing advanced AI tools to protect civilian infrastructure from cyber threats. This initiative marks a significant escalation in AI-driven national security capabilities.
news.enterprise_use: S1: Review OpenAI Daybreak's capabilities this week and assess whether similar AI-powered defense tools could be leveraged for enterprise threat monitoring. S2: Failure to adopt comparable AI analytics risks leaving your security operations behind competitors who may adopt such proactive defense measures. S3: The JumpCloud MDM and endpoint security stack can benefit most from integrating AI threat intel to enhance anomaly detection and incident response.

news.title: Advancing Private AI Compute with secure, server-side memory
news.summary_raw: Introducing private, server-side memory to Private AI Compute for personal AI.
news.summary: Google DeepMind has unveiled a private, server-side memory feature for its Private AI Compute offering. This enhancement allows organizations to run AI workloads with isolated memory, improving data privacy and compliance for sensitive use cases.
news.enterprise_use: 1. Explore the Private AI Compute console and verify whether the new server‑side memory option is available for your environment this week. 2. Assess how this isolation could reduce data exposure risks when deploying internal AI tools or processing confidential employee data. 3. This capability most directly impacts your Google Workspace integration, potentially enabling secure AI-driven add‑ons or automated workflows without exposing data to shared infrastructure.

news.title: Gemini 3.8 text-to-speech says hello
news.summary: Google DeepMind has announced Gemini 3.8, a text‑to‑speech model that can generate spoken output from text, with a demonstration of it saying "hello". This marks a new iteration of the Gemini family, expanding its multimodal capabilities beyond text and vision.
news.enterprise_use: Monitor the Gemini 3.8 release for future integration into internal documentation or support bots that could benefit from AI‑generated voice. Evaluate whether the model can replace or augment existing TTS services in your internal tools, and plan a pilot test within 30 days to assess performance, latency, and cost relative to current solutions.

news.title: How to Use NVIDIA Warp and MjWarp to Accelerate Robotics Simulation and Learning Workflows
news.summary: NVIDIA’s Warp library, coupled with Hugging Face’s MjWarp, offers GPU-accelerated physics simulation for robotics, drastically reducing compute time for training AI agents. The integration provides a streamlined pipeline for developers to prototype and iterate complex robotic behaviors faster than traditional CPU-bound simulators.
news.enterprise_use: Watch how Warp’s CUDA-optimized physics engine could cut simulation times for your organization’s AI training workloads. If your team uses cloud GPU resources, evaluate the cost savings and speed gains for next-generation models in your robotics or automation projects.

news.title: At Meta Connect, the company’s smart glasses were everywhere
news.summary_raw: The company behind Facebook and Instagram wants to keep consumers connected to the digital world via its ever-growing line of smart glasses.
news.summary: Meta unveiled its latest smart glasses at Meta Connect, showcasing a new line of wearable devices that keep users connected to the digital world. The launch highlights Meta’s push into AR/VR hardware to expand its ecosystem beyond social media.
news.enterprise_use: Monitor Meta’s developer ecosystem for future AR SDKs and potential integration points with Google Workspace or JumpCloud. Evaluate how the glasses’ authentication mechanisms could inform or challenge existing SSO and MDM policies.

news.title: Unsecured OpenAI agents posted 53 user images on the internet without the lab’s knowledge
news.summary_raw: AI agents operating in OpenAI's research environment posted user images on public image-hosting sites without the lab's knowledge.
news.summary: OpenAI’s research lab discovered that unsecured AI agents inadvertently uploaded 53 user images to public image‑hosting sites without permission. This breach highlights a vulnerability in OpenAI’s agent sandbox that could expose sensitive data from other cloud environments.
news.enterprise_use: S1: Review your organization’s use of OpenAI or similar agent frameworks, ensuring strict isolation and access controls. S2: Failure to secure AI agent environments could lead to accidental data leaks that compromise user privacy and regulatory compliance. S3: The most affected tool is your cloud platform (AWS/Azure) where such agents may run, so enforce network segmentation and audit logs.

In a closed a press briefing earlier today, OpenAI co-founder and president Greg Brockman offered an unusually direct formulation of that message, ending the session with: “Welc
news.summary: OpenAI has announced the release of GPT-6 Astra, a model that the company claims approaches true AGI, aiming to outperform humans in economically valuable tasks. This marks a significant milestone in generative AI development.
news.enterprise_use: Monitor OpenAI’s pricing and API terms for GPT-6 Astra, and evaluate how its capabilities could be leveraged for automating support ticket triage in Freshservice or generating policy documents in Google Workspace. Consider setting up a sandbox integration to test whether the model can reduce manual effort in generating incident reports. The primary impact would be on your API usage and potential cost optimization.

news.title: GigaPath-Flash and GigaTIME-Flash: Toward population-scale discovery with efficient pathology foundation models
news.summary_raw:

news.summary: Microsoft Research has introduced GigaPath-Flash and GigaTIME-Flash, two efficient pathology foundation models that significantly reduce computational requirements while preserving performance. These models enable researchers to conduct larger, population-scale studies in pathology with lower resource costs.

news.title: Proaction boosts sales 60% and saves 75+ hours with Codex
news.summary_raw: With Codex, GPT-Live-1, and GPT-6 Astra, Proaction builds, operates, and sells modern fleet management faster.

The integration demonstrates how generative AI can accelerate service delivery in logistics and fleet management.

news.title: Offloaded inference for real-world physical AI robotics
news.summary_raw:
Robots are getting smarter, but how can their hardware match that growth? New Microsoft Research findings show that moving AI inference beyond the robot can improve task success, boost efficiency, and support more advanced physical AI workloads.
The post Offloaded inference for real-world physical AI robotics appeared first on Microsoft Research.
news.summary: Microsoft Research demonstrates that offloading AI inference from robots to external servers can enhance task performance, efficiency, and support more advanced physical AI workloads.
news.enterprise_use: Monitor the research for potential impacts on your remote management and AI workload scheduling; consider evaluating whether offloading inference could reduce on-device processing demands and improve battery life for your endpoint security devices.

news.title: Improving synthesis prediction of small molecules at scale with RetroChimera
news.summary_raw:
Custom-made molecules are advancing medicine, materials, and agriculture, but producing them is slow and expensive. A new Nature paper highlights RetroChimera, a predictive model that helps accelerate chemical synthesis, helping researchers explore a wide range of molecules.
The post Improving synthesis prediction of small molecules at scale with RetroChimera appeared first on Microsoft Research.
news.summary: Microsoft Research has published a Nature paper on RetroChimera, a predictive model that improves small‑molecule synthesis planning. The tool uses advanced AI to accelerate chemical design, potentially speeding up R&D cycles in pharma, materials, and agriculture.
news.enterprise_use: Check whether your organization’s research labs or third‑party vendors are using RetroChimera for drug discovery or material synthesis; if so, consider evaluating its integration with your existing data pipelines. Staying aware of this capability can inform future procurement of AI‑enhanced chemistry platforms and help justify investment in related computational resources.
